name: Obliterator

bonuses.name: Agent of Apocalypse
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: This Threat has a Mark of Chaos (W&G p.136)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Gain bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (W&G p.75)

abilities.text: Before declaring a target, the Obliterator must choose the mode of fire from the three below. This is used for the round of combat.
In melee combat the Obliterator uses its Crushing Fists

abilities.name: Second Strike
abilities.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Attack penalty by 2 DN, as though is had the Dual Wield Talent (W&G, page 133).

abilities.name: Witness Annihilation!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to increase the Salvo rating of an attack by 1.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 10d6. Obliterators can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Print error copied as printed: Second Strike reads 'as though is had'. No Architect of Ruin bonus; Agent of Apocalypse is the Champion bonus under another name (personal Ruin 2).
